arc_relay_spark: 0.30 s. A real snap (misc_05) on the attack, a 50 ms resonant zap swept 3.6 kHz->700 Hz cut from the buzz recording, 0.3 s of the recorded crackle (Electric Buzz, sped 1.2x so the buzz sits at 120 Hz) decaying with tau 55 ms, and a saturated 300-1500 Hz body from the same crackle (tau 35 ms). Final chain: 150 Hz 24 dB/oct HP, -7 dB shelf at 5 kHz, 9.5 kHz 24 dB/oct LP, +3 dB at 1 kHz, a lookahead peak limiter (11 dB here, 8 dB default), 0.5 ms / 40 ms raised-cosine fades, peak -6.02 dBFS. Crackle and body layers are gated by |sin(2*pi*60 t)| (120 Hz re-strikes).
arc_exit_bolt: 0.80 s. 0-0.55 s: a continuous run of the recorded crackle swelling from -17 dB to -9 dB (power 1.4 curve), half-cycle gated at 120 Hz and lightly saturated, through a low-pass opening 1.5 kHz->9 kHz, with its saturated 300-1500 Hz body and the Kenney forceField hum (200 Hz+ harmonics only, -32 -> -12 dB) underneath; a 25 ms duck to -9 dB; at 0.55 s the misc_05 snap doubled by a 0.8x-speed copy 1.5 ms later and limited 7 dB on its own, an 80 ms zap swept 5 kHz->500 Hz and the weird_05 sizzle tail, while the crackle decays with tau 70 ms. Final chain as the relay spark but the limiter only pulls 5 dB so the snap stays about 6 dB over the build; 50 ms end fade.
arc_records_exit: 0.65 s. The misc_05 snap at 0 s with a 65 ms zap swept 4.2 kHz->600 Hz, 0.65 s of the recorded crackle (tau 160 ms with an extra 30 ms burst), its saturated 300-1500 Hz body (tau 90 ms), the weird_05 sizzle shower and a second, smaller snap (misc_05 at 0.85x speed, -9 dB) at 175 ms. Same final chain, 60 ms end fade.
